cleaned_entries.title: FastAPI PostgreSQL-backed Dockerfile
cleaned_entries.content:
FastAPI PostgreSQL-backed Dockerfile

FastAPI Dockerfile aligned with a PostgreSQL-backed service. Base image: python:3.11-slim. Installs pip requirements, sets ENV PORT=8000, exposes 8000. CMD uses ${PORT:-8000} for configurable port binding at runtime.

Decision rules:
- Use when framework=fastapi, project_type=api_backend, dependencies include postgres
- Use PORT env variable to allow dynamic port assignment in orchestration environments

Trade-offs:
- No multi-stage build — simpler but larger final image than a distroless multi-stage variant
- No non-root user — extend with USER directive before CMD for production security

Anti-patterns:
- Do not embed DATABASE_URL or credentials in the Dockerfile
- Do not expose the database port inside the application container Dockerfile
